costRevenueImpactInformation.costRevenueImpactShortDescription: Cost of DATSs (maintenance + annual fees)
Initial investment for the DATSs
Cost of water:By estimating and modelling soil water availability and crop irrigation demand, the DATS enables optimized irrigation, reducing water consumption
